sensors.description: The sensors for which to retrieve or create {@link SensorDataSummary} entities.

sensorFilter.description: Used as a backup for {@link getSensors} if {@link sensors} is not specified.

timeRange.description: The time range for which to retrieve or create {@link SensorDataSummary} entities.

interval.description: The interval for which to retrieve or create {@link SensorDataSummary} entities.

title:
A specification for retrieving or creating {@link SensorDataSummary} entities for a

name: SensorDataSummarySpec
